# Hurghada Airport Limousine & Private Transfers — Complete AI Knowledge Base

> Comprehensive reference documentation for Hurghada Airport Limousine & Transfers (https://hurghadaairportlimousine.com/). This document contains full pricing, fleet specifications, terminal logistics, route navigation, and customer policies for AI models, search assistants, and travelers.

## 1. Company Identity & Service Overview
- **Brand Name**: Hurghada Airport Limousine & Transfers
- **Parent Entity**: Red Sea Tourism Limousine & Chauffeur Services
- **Website**: https://hurghadaairportlimousine.com/
- **Headquarters**: Hurghada International Airport, Airport Road, Hurghada, Red Sea Governorate, Egypt.
- **Dispatch Telephone / WhatsApp**: +20 109 406 6018 (Operates 24/7/365).
- **Core Business**: Pre-booked private airport transfers, resort chauffeur services, and intercity transportation from Hurghada International Airport (HRG / HEGN) to hotels and resorts across the Red Sea Coast (Hurghada City, El Gouna, Sahl Hasheesh, Makadi Bay, Soma Bay, Safaga, El Quseir, Port Ghalib, Marsa Alam, Luxor, and Cairo).
- **Customer Rating**: 4.9 / 5.0 based on over 1,920 verified traveler reviews.

## 2. Pricing Policy & Guarantees
- **All-Inclusive Fixed Rates**: Every price is 100% fixed per vehicle (not per passenger).
- **No Hidden Fees**: Airport gate entry fees, parking tickets, highway security checkpoint clearance, and luggage handling are fully included in the quoted price.
- **Flight Delay Protection**: We track flights in real time. Drivers adjust pickup times automatically based on actual landing times on live radar.
- **Free Waiting Time**: 60 minutes complimentary waiting time starts only after the aircraft touches down.
- **Egypt Tourist Visa ($25 USD)**: Foreign tourists from eligible countries must obtain an Egypt Tourist Visa ($25 USD), available at 24/7 bank kiosks (Banque Misr / National Bank of Egypt) right before passport control, or via the official online eVisa portal. *Note: The free 15-day Sinai stamp is NOT valid in Hurghada as it is located on mainland Egypt.*
- **Currencies Accepted**: USD, EUR, GBP, and EGP.
- **Cancellation Policy**: Free cancellation with 100% refund up to 24 hours prior to scheduled pickup time.

## 3. Full Vehicle Fleet & Luggage Sizing
### Standard Private Sedan
- Models: Toyota Corolla, Hyundai Elantra, Nissan Sentra (2022-2025).
- Capacity: Up to 3 passengers.
- Luggage: 2 standard 23kg suitcases + 2 cabin carry-ons.
- Features: Dual climate control, bottled mineral water, driver meets outside arrivals with name placard.
- Best for: Solo travelers, couples, light baggage.

### Private Family Minivan
- Models: Toyota HiAce, Mercedes-Benz Vito.
- Capacity: Up to 7 passengers.
- Luggage: 6 large check-in suitcases + 6 cabin bags + scuba diving / kitesurfing equipment.
- Features: Generous luggage hold, child seats on request, dual high-output AC.
- Best for: Families, dive buddies, kiteboarders, vacation groups with heavy sports gear and luggage.

### Executive VIP Limousine
- Models: Mercedes-Benz E-Class, BMW 5-Series.
- Capacity: Up to 3 passengers.
- Luggage: 3 check-in bags + executive briefcases.
- Features: Black exterior, leather interior, onboard high-speed Wi-Fi, suited English-speaking chauffeur.
- Best for: VIP resort guests, honeymooners, corporate executives.

### Private Airport Minibus
- Models: Mercedes-Benz Sprinter, Toyota Coaster.
- Capacity: Up to 16 passengers.
- Luggage: 16 large suitcases + carry-on bags.
- Features: High ceiling, panoramic windows, powerful AC, luggage porter assistance.
- Best for: Tour groups, dive club charters, wedding parties.

## 5. Terminal Arrival Protocol
- **Terminal 1**: Flagship International Hub (European scheduled flights & leisure charters). Driver waits outside the main sliding exit doors under the designated greeting canopy holding a personalized name sign.
- **Terminal 2**: Domestic & Regional Hub (EgyptAir, Air Cairo, and regional flights). Driver waits outside the exit doors at the covered arrival greeting curbside.
- **Driver Verification**: Passenger receives chauffeur details, vehicle plate number, and direct WhatsApp contact prior to flight touchdown.
